cases.note: required C# sources present as a safe snapshot; rejects binaries, links and private-harness markers
Core, Bill Autopilot slice and verifier loaded
passes on the starter: its fixture changes neither the stamp mode nor the counts

clauses.anchor: Required behavior, bullet 1: every non-null repeat mode other than TargetCount, Forever and RepeatCount is foreign-owned
Required behavior, bullet 2: do not flatten a foreign mode into an Autopilot mode when capturing UI drift
clauses.note: foreign-drift-not-flattened already passes on the starter, so no case can fail when the drift guard is missing

clauses.anchor: Required behavior, bullet 3: before deleting an owned bill, remember its foreign repeat-mode defName with external bill memory
Required behavior, bullet 4: restore a resolvable remembered mode when recreating and let its ShouldDoNow decide
Required behavior, bullet 5: preserve TargetCount, Forever, RepeatCount, unresolved-mode, busy-bill, name, linked-group, serialization and target/floor behavior
closing paragraph: do not add RimWorld, Unity or Harmony binaries, generated output, test results, credentials, Workshop content, assets, saves or logs
clauses.note: the snapshot gate rejects binaries, links and harness markers; the other listed artefacts are not checked

known_issues: The suite reaches production code by name: AutoBillSync.IsForeignMode, Create, Remove, CaptureDrift and ShouldRetire, BillMemory.repeatModeDefName saved under the Scribe label "repeatMode", and RecipeProbe.TryShouldDoNow(table, recipe, memory, mode, target, floor, out due). The exam names none of these, so an otherwise correct fix with other names fails target cases.
busy-bill-not-retired never makes the bill busy (the fixture map has no pawns); it observes that a non-foreign bill below target is not retired.
